tagline: Fuji胶片单反相机，1975 年发布
description: Fuji于1975年推出的胶片单反相机。快门速度Mechanical cloth focal-plane shutter. B + 1/2nd - 1/700th sec. Self-timer.。使用Single-stroke lever with 140° winding angle.。感光度20 to 1600 ASA.。

specs.卡口: Praktica M42 screw, List of available Fujinon lenses.
specs.快门: Mechanical cloth focal-plane shutter. B + 1/2nd - 1/700th sec. Self-timer.
specs.曝光测光: Manual match needle metering, with indicator visible in viewfinder.
specs.尺寸: 133 x 86 x 88mm (W x H x D) with lens.
